findings: Root cause: kernel_agent_create's input shape is charter: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) (kernel/src/agents/charter-tools.ts:298), the only z.record among shipped tools. The Agent SDK builds each tool's JSON Schema with a zod walker bundled in sdk.mjs that hands a record to the kernel's zod 4.6.5 recordProcessor, which throws. One throwing schema fails the whole tools/list, so the CLI shows the kernel server as connected while offering none of its tools. Every Wright session since item 07 (PR #91) merged is affected, not only crew creation.
Ruled out: Loomwright 17.10.0 (17.6.1 by path fails the same way) and Node (v24.11.1 also in phase 3's passing run).
